name: ssc
description: Shadowspire Cathedral (SSC) levels 1 and 2 as Logan Wolf went through them, played by the user in captures 20261024_102346, 20261024_225113 (2026-10-24/25), 20261031_132152 (10-31) and 20261103_101743 (11-03): seven visits, each by the tome row 'SSC Inside' to level 1's arrival (5144, 2480, 39) beside its golden moongate 0x40035E71 (visit 7 by the DTF house's dungeon moongate, (5138, 2484, 40)), level 1 or down its south strip (5132-5133, 2653) to level 2 (5276-5277, 2640, 33), out by a moongate to Totem (crimson 0x40035E72 (5157, 2647) five times, golden 0x40035E70 (5176, 2489) and 0x40035E71 (5145, 2480) once each) and the tome home. Dead once on level 1 to two red players (2026-10-31 14:24:50). Levels by a map flood fill (localmap._flood from each arrival; all of Logan's steps there walk on the map): level 1 x 5097-5195, y 2462-2660 (4,476 tiles; 2,504 s there), level 2 x 5241-5359, y 2416-2644 (11,548; 2,498 s). Level 2's surface exit (5309, 2638) and the east wing (boss and silver-gate rooms, visit 7) are out of the scenario. Pets: GirthyEarthy and a tidal mantis (visit 1), GirthyEarthy, fireminion and a searing imp (visits 2-4), NightmareA, NightmareB and a searing imp (visit 5), AlaFlambe and Bussin (visits 6-7): run.py --team phoenix_incubus for the last

calibration.note: sim/calibrate.py's region: one box per level (the flood fills padded by 5); the east wing (x 5415-5530) and the grounds outside lie outside both. Captures: the user's seven visits (description)

teleporters_note: captures, each the tile the step before the jump went for ('from'): level 1's south strip S from (5132-5133, 2652) to level 2's landing (5276-5277, 2640, 33), the column kept (x + 144, y - 13): 10-24 20:23:03, 20:23:14 (SW from (5133, 2652)), 22:40:41 (SW), 22:40:48, 22:54:37, 10-25 11:05:01, 11-03 22:02:32; level 2's strip N (once NE) from its floor at (5276-5277, 2642) back to (5132-5133, 2654, 36): 10-24 20:32:12, 22:40:46, 22:52:06, 23:04:36, 10-25 11:18:39, 11-03 22:22:31; once after standing 2.1 s on (5276, 2641) (10-24 20:23:05) [INFERENCE: a turn there]. **One way only.** Each arrival is a 2-tile pocket whose only way out crosses the other strip's row, and the step off it never fired. Level 1: N from (5132-5133, 2654) onto the strip 6 of 6 times and W along it (10-24 22:39:13, two steps) walked on; S and SW onto it fired: `dirs` [3, 4, 5] (SE [INFERENCE]). Level 2: its landing (z 33) is the top of a stair that spirals down to the floor (-25) under it; S off the landing onto (5276-5277, 2641) is the stair (z 28) and walked on 6 of 6 times, N and NE onto it from the floor fired 6 of 6: `z` [-30, 0], the floor [INFERENCE: a teleporter fires only for a mobile at its height (RunUO's OnMoveOver z check); a step onto it on the floor from the north, never seen, fires here too]. Level 2's surface exit (5309, 2638) put Logan outside at (3393, 816, -23) (11-03 22:02:43, a step S from (5309, 2637); the SSC grounds, the 'SSC West Entrance' rune (3353, 762)); N from (3394, 818) onto (3394, 817) put him back at (5310, 2640, -25) (22:22:00).
